end.summary:
Ayaan practised choosing exact or approximate values in everyday situations.
They identified when an exact count was needed for pencil colours and an approximate count for a fair.
They rounded large numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, and crore.
Rounding to crore was corrected after an initial mix-up; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised exact versus approximate values and rounding large numbers. Ayaan used the reason that approximate values are easier to say and recognised that “lagbhag” signals an estimate. There was a mix-up while rounding 8,64,20,000 to crore, which was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Ayaan to round prices or visitor counts to the nearest thousand, lakh, or crore and explain why.
